create.name: YAP Integral Yoga Centre
create.bio:
YAP Integral Yoga Centre is a non-profit association in Teramo, in the Abruzzo hills, that has taught yoga since 2004 and has been an officially recognised Integral Yoga centre since 2009. It follows Swami Satchidananda, a disciple of Swami Sivananda, and his principle that truth is one while the paths to it are many. The centre was founded by Alessandra Uma Cocchi, an Integral Yoga teacher trainer, who serves as vice-president; Alessandra Zancocchia chairs the association, and the teaching team works in a spirit of karma yoga rather than as a business.

Regular Integral Hatha Yoga classes, at several levels, follow the tradition's classic sequence of concentration, sun salutations, postures, guided relaxation, breathing and a closing meditation, and short meditation sittings are free to members several mornings a week. Other teachers offer hatha yoga in the Himalayan tradition of Swami Rama, an early-morning vinyasa class, a hatha class taught entirely in English, children's yoga modules and tai chi. Practice takes place in two Teramo venues, one on a stepped lane in the old town, with many sessions also streamed online. Since 2015 the centre has also been Italy's main base for Accessible Yoga teacher education, run with the international Accessible Yoga network.

courses.title: Integral Yoga e Meditazione Yoga (corsi regolari)
courses.description: Weekly Integral Hatha Yoga classes at mixed and advanced levels, in person in Teramo and online, taught by three Integral Yoga teachers. Short silent meditation sittings with breath focus and mantra run on several mornings and are free to members.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (prima lezione gratuita; meditazione gratuita per Soci)

courses.title: Yoga in English (Hridaya Hatha Yoga)
courses.description: A Wednesday-evening hatha class taught entirely in English by Ingrid Goudsmit, trained in the Hridaya style. The practice is slow and inward-looking, for fluent and learning English speakers alike.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (lezioni singole o nei pacchetti dello Yoga tradizionale; quota associativa)

courses.title: Slow Flow Yoga
courses.description: An hour of flowing vinyasa practice at 6:30 on Friday mornings with Luana Di Gaetano, joined in the old-town studio or from home. It can be booked singly or as part of a yoga pass.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (fruibile singolarmente con quota associativa o negli abbonamenti)

courses.title: YAP Lounge #2: Yoga, tisane e letture
courses.description: An unhurried Saturday afternoon gathering with a practice for all levels, herbal tea, readings and informal sharing, this time led by Luana Di Gaetano. It is planned as a monthly meeting.

flags: Lead from the Integral Yoga Teachers Association's centre directory (iyta.org/directory/centers/): 'YAP Integral Yoga Centre', Alessandra Uma Cocchi, Teramo, centroyap.it. Facts from the centre's own site (robots.txt allows us).

Health rule: the centre also runs a yoga-therapy strand (cardiac, oncology, gastrointestinal and other conditions) and yoga for children with named disabilities; all of it is left out of the bio and items. It is one strand among regular classes, so the school is not skipped, but the owner may want to look.

Lineage note: Swami Satchidananda (died 2002) faced sexual-misconduct allegations in the 1990s; from general knowledge, no source opened. Nothing found about the centre's current leadership. The site also names Swami Rama (Himalayan Institute founder, died 1996, also subject of abuse allegations, general knowledge) as the reference teacher for one class.
Guest: a 28 Nov 2026 online talk by Jivana Heyman (founder of Accessible Yoga) on yoga and social justice; not linked and left out (guest, and political-leaning topic). Not on Spiritpedia.
